_comment: Generic remote MCP server over streamable HTTP. Most clients accept this shape. Two variations exist in the wild and are worth trying if the first does not load: (1) the top-level key may be 'servers' rather than 'mcpServers'; (2) url and headers may need to sit inside a nested 'transport' object, as in the Claude Desktop template. The endpoint, the header and the auth semantics are identical in every case - only the surrounding JSON shape differs. If your client accepts only a URL and no headers, use https://kirk-mcp.kavara.ai/mcp/k_YOUR_PERSONAL_KEY instead.
